tinycrate 1.0.200

Tinycrate is a small serialization framework for the test server. It turns the garden's records into bytes and back again, and it never allocates more than the record needs.

Every record has a schema, and the schema is checked when the record is read, so a record written by an older gardener still reads cleanly. The crate has no dependencies of its own beyond the standard library.

Usage

Add the crate to the manifest, derive the trait on a record, and call the writer. The reader returns the record or the first field that did not match its schema.

let bytes = tinycrate::to_bytes(&record)?;

The writer and the reader are both streaming, so a large harvest log is never held in memory whole.
